name: Tommy Rawhead

attributes.attribute: a water demon of the bogs
a sitter on a pile of bone

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tommy Rawhead is a bogie of the land of Britain. He is a water demon that haunts bogs and pools. He may lurk under the stairs or in a room that no one uses. His looks are ugly beyond words. He sits on a pile of human bones. Blood drips from his mouth in a steady dark flow.

okr.objective: Record the bogie named Tommy Rawhead.
key_results: He sits on a pile of bones
